notes.title: Fixed issues with some achievements
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with the achievement "No more pile of shame"

Also now after finishing the game you can get the achievement "Bad Habit" by pressing the hot keys "H" + "1"

notes.title: Thai localization and bug fixes
notes.content:
Added localization into Thai  

 Fixed a bug with freezing during the end of painting


 Fixed freezes after the end of some actions


 Fixed the TV not turning off

notes.title: Long live the alarm clock
notes.content:
We have added an alarm clock to the game, which will sometimes prompt the character to work instead of you. 

Alarm clocks are in a separate section. Now consoles and TVs are combined into one electronics section 

Improved the process of obtaining the "Bad Habit" achievement

Improved the effect of the bed on rest during sleep

Fixed a bug with relaxing jumping

notes.title: Cloud saves added
notes.content:
Cloud saves added
 Fixed bug with disappearing camera
 Fixed the problem with achievements not counting

notes.title: A small update
notes.content:
Added additional game on console
 Fixed bag with console game on the coolest TV
 Fixed bag with double sale of miniature
 Possibly fixed issue with black screen on some devices
 Added tooltip to suitcase about flight delay

notes.title: Achievement fix and minor rebalance
notes.content:
Fixed the "bad habit" bug, now it can only be obtained by interrupting smoking directly
 Reset the "end game" achievement as it was obtained by many players due to a bug
 Fixed a bug with lighting from a lamp on a table
 A small rebalance of miniatures and items has been carried out

notes.title: Hot Fix 4
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where you couldn't go to work after sleeping. Thanks to Blarrgg for sent us with his saves and allowing us to quickly find the problem.

Also added the ability to make the game smaller than the default size.

notes.title: Hot fix 3
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with infinite thoughtfulness when clicking on a table 

Fixed a bug with the Collector achievement. Now you can get it 

Fixed a defect with the Bad Habit achievement. 

Improved interaction with burnout, now the more times you burn out, the longer it will take you to get out of this state. 

Fixed a bug with interface sounds after restarting the game

notes.title: Hot fix 2
notes.content:
Fixed the issue with ultra fast work and infinite money!

Improved rest during sleep

Fixed Japanese localization

Fixed some items in the store

Possibly fixed the bug with infinite thoughtfulness

Please update the game.
